comment: Revision anchor for the GNU master differential oracle. tests/differential/fetch-gnu-master.sh verifies every source against these values and refuses a source that cannot prove them; see DOCS/gate-oracle-policy.md.

retry.note: Defaults live in tests/differential/fetch-gnu-master.sh; this block is the reviewed contract, not a second configuration source.

vendored_note: GitHub archive of the gnulib commit that coreutils 5f6c02d3 pins. Re-vendor only together with a new coreutils revision, and recompute vendored_sha256 and tree_sha256 in the same commit.
